critic.scope: All 10,866 cards (10,779 item cards in 19 kinds + 87 recipes) by keyword sweep (95 capability patterns over every card's name, menu path and text fields); 40 cards read in full from a seeded random sample (random.Random(20261013), 2 per kind across all 20 kinds) plus 31 deliberate picks read for the fields that mattered (summary, how, scripting / script_api, avoid, verified); 15 gallery frames opened and judged; python pgd.py stats, python pipeline.py status, PGD.md rebuilt to a scratch path with build_docs.py; the harvest's error items in all 19 kinds; gallery/*/failed.json; the Photoshop, Illustrator and CorelDRAW verify, recheck, re-verify, re-render and live-chain reports; all 87 recipes with every plan step resolved to its card.
critic.inventory: 10,779 harvested items, all carded (validate_cards.py: 394 files clean, 0 issues), plus 87 recipes = 10,866 cards. Render-verified: 531 visual cards (pass 402, weak 6, wrong 45, broken 12, not_rendered 66) and 6,834 presets (pass 5,402, weak 22, wrong 428, not_rendered 982); all 473 'wrong' cards were rewritten from their own frame (rerender false). Reviewed only, by design: 3,414 api / menu / tool cards (api 1,454, menu 1,665, tool 295), 566 of the api cards being harvest-only skeletons (527 enums). Recipes: 87 in 8 families (confidence high 20, medium 67), 207 app plans (PS 72, AI 58, CDR 77), all passing pgd.py check, none ever run. Harvest items carrying an error: AI menu 330 of 697, AI tool 88 of 136, CDR preset 92, PS filter 19, CDR effect 18, PS tool 11, PS blend mode 11, AI preset 8, PS adjustment 5, CDR tool 4, AI effect 2, PS layer style 1.
critic.method: A gap is a capability a professional designer relies on that no card or recipe covers as a working, scriptable technique: zero hits, or only a menu / api card with no how-to or no proven route. A weak card is one whose own text is overstated, stale or thin against the harvest and the reports. A doubt is a limit on what the verification actually proves. Random sample: Justification, PathPoints (ai_api); Multiply, Hue (ai_blend_mode); Extrude & Bevel, Texturizer (ai_effect); Tile, Skew (ai_menu); Paintbrush - Wide, Heavy Golden Dawn Clean (ai_preset); Blend Mode - Normal, Area Type Tool (ai_tool); ITableColumn, cdrFeatherType (cdr_api); Block Shadow, Magnify (cdr_effect); Detailed Logo, Dynamic Guides (cdr_menu); paint stroke_rainbow, Japan Color 2001 Uncoated (cdr_preset); Zoom, Color Eyedropper (cdr_tool); Gradient Map, Color Lookup (ps_adjustment); CameraRAWOpenOptions, GalleryImagesOptions (ps_api); Dissolve, Darker Color (ps_blend_mode); Mosaic Tiles, Texturizer (ps_filter); Color Overlay, Inner Glow (ps_layer_style); Exit, Tile (ps_menu); Striped Cone (Button), Time (ps_preset); Patch Tool, Sharpen Tool (ps_tool); Starburst, scallop and zigzag badge edges, Neon tube glow (recipe). Deliberate picks: PS Convert to Smart Object, Create Clipping Mask, Select and Mask, Subject, Generative Fill, Content-Aware Fill, Replace Contents, Warp Text, Middle Eastern Features, Camera Raw Filter, Reduce Noise, Add Noise, Shape Blur, TextComposer; AI Divide, Trap, Drop Shadow, Image Trace, Recolor Artwork, TracingOptions, Type on a Path Tool, ComposerEngineType, Artboards (api and menu); CDR Tune Blur, Canvas, PowerClip (api and effect), Create/load Print Merge, Object Styles, Color Styles. Frames judged: Shape Blur (1:1), Reduce Noise (1:1), Channel Mixer layer, Curves, Inner Glow, Dissolve, Watercolor 1 brush (PS); Dark Strokes, Divide, RGB Cartographic - Ocean Ridges, Arrow Brush Floral 2 (AI); Directional Smooth (1:1), Magnify, Glass Default, 4 Point North Star (CDR). I agree with all 15 verdicts as verdicts on their frames; Arrow Brush Floral 2 and the Gradient Map passes are in doubtful because the frame does not show what the card is mainly about. The test photo's people are not described here.

gaps.gap: No plan runner, so no recipe has ever run. pgd.py check pre-flights a plan statically (names, params, types, ranges), but nothing in the repo executes a plan in Photoshop, Illustrator or CorelDRAW: the renderers (tools/<app>/effect_gallery.py) apply one card's demo to a fresh plate. None of the 87 recipes has a verified field, 62 carry manual steps and 54 steps use needs_input items. Step order, which layer or object each step acts on and how effects stack are exactly what a single-effect gallery cannot test.
gaps.fixed: 2026-10-15: run_plan.py runs a recipe plan step by step in the live app on a known input document (backends tools/ps/plan_ps.py, tools/cdr/plan_cdr.py, tools/ai/plan_ai.py, each reusing its app's effect gallery) and records the run in the recipe card; independent judges then record a verdict from the final frame, the step strip and a 1:1 crop, with a second opinion on every non-pass. PS: 72/72 plans run (67 complete, 5 partial, 0 manual, 0 failed), judged 66 pass / 6 weak / 0 wrong / 0 broken, 6 non-pass verdicts with a second opinion; CDR: 77/77 plans run (69 complete, 8 partial, 0 manual, 0 failed), judged 70 pass / 7 weak / 0 wrong / 0 broken, 7 non-pass verdicts with a second opinion. Illustrator: 58 plans compile, none run yet (the runner only drives an Illustrator it started, and another one was open). Two fix rounds turned the first judging's non-pass plans into passes or documented limits; what the runs taught went into pgd.py check (CorelDRAW calls missing required values, a drop shadow hidden under an outside stroke), the cards (about 40 cards corrected with 16 groups of app facts, each citing the recipe run that showed it) and the plan format.

gaps.gap: The plan format has no layer / object model. A step is {kind, name | id, settings, note}: no target (which layer, object, selection or path), no input (file, text, selection), no grouping. In the recipes: 22 Photoshop plans list two or more ps_layer_style steps although every layer-style card says a 'set' writes the layer's whole layerEffects object, so a step-by-step run keeps only the last style (Neon tube glow, Gold metallic type, Die-cut sticker type, Retro 80s sunset chrome ...); Illustrator glow and shadow colours (FillStyle sclr / gclr) cannot be put in settings and live in manual_steps; masks, clipping and selection order exist only in notes. pgd.py check cannot see any of this.
gaps.fixed: 2026-10-15: plans now carry "input" (photo / text / vector / blank plates, type on any plate, synthetic photo damage for clean-up recipes), "target" / "as" / "labels" (which layer or object a step acts on; labels follow a layer or shape a step replaces), and "script" (the app's own code for API, tool and dialog steps; whether it carries Illustrator's FillStyle colours is untested until the Illustrator plans run). pgd.py check validates all of it; the 22 stacked layer-style plans were regrouped on 2026-10-13.

gaps.gap: Non-destructive compositing as a technique. Each command has a card (Layer Mask Reveal / Hide All and Selection, Create Clipping Mask, Convert to Smart Object, Select Subject (verified live), Select and Mask, Replace Contents, Apply Image, Calculations), but no card or recipe says how to build a layer stack by script: mask from a selection, an adjustment clipped to one layer, smart filters with a filter mask, Blend If ranges (16 hits, all in blend-mode pairs_with lines), luminosity masks from channels (no card), frequency separation (4 passing mentions).

Templates and variable data (one template, many outputs). Photoshop Data Sets / Variable Data Sets (scriptable no / partial), Illustrator Variables + DataSets (api cards, one menu card), CorelDRAW Print Merge (3 menu cards with a one-line how; InvokeItem only opens the wizard; no data-file format, no scripted route) and Smart Object Replace Contents (verified live) are all there as items, but no recipe covers the batch job a design system runs most: fill a template per record (text, photo, colour), export, revert, with a scripted fallback when the merge UI cannot be driven.

Screen and social delivery. 12 recipes cover print production; screen delivery has only output sharpening. Artboard export (AI Export for Screens and ExportForScreensOptions*; the AI Artboards menu card is scriptable no), Photoshop Export As / Quick Export / Artboards to Files (partial), CorelDRAW Export / QuickExport api, multi-size social sets, file naming, conversion to sRGB with an embedded profile and JPEG / WebP quality-versus-size budgets: no recipe and no verified export in any app.

Complex-script type (Devanagari, Arabic). The only card that names Devanagari is ps_menu Middle Eastern Features (scriptable no, never executed, confidence medium). Photoshop's text-engine choice and Illustrator's World-Ready composer have no how-to (ai_api ComposerEngineType lists optycaComposer with no meaning; ps_api TextComposer lists only the two Latin composers); CorelDRAW complex-script shaping is not described; no render proves that matras, conjuncts or Arabic joining come out right. For a design system that sets Hindi or Arabic headlines this is the first text failure it will meet.

Typography workflow and fonts. No recipe for a type hierarchy (paragraph / character styles exist only as panel cards), OpenType features, tracking and kerning by script, or fitting text to a frame. Fonts: no card says how a script checks that a font is installed before a plan runs, resolves missing fonts (AI Resolve Missing Fonts and Find/Replace Font are menu cards only) or activates one (Corel Font Manager: 3 api cards, no how; Adobe Fonts not covered). 'Package fonts and links' is the only font recipe.

Generative and AI features are described, never run. Generative Fill (needs_input, scriptable no; the 'syntheticFill' event is unverified), Generative Expand (no card of its own, only mentions), Generative Upscale, Illustrator Generative Recolor, Generative Shape Fill and Text to Vector (scriptable no), Neural Filters, AI Denoise, AI Sharpen: all need the cloud or credits, so the harvest skipped them and their cards are documentation, not verified knowledge.

Camera Raw and the other no-event Photoshop filters. Camera Raw Filter (the main photo-grading tool), Blur Gallery x5 (Field, Iris, Tilt-Shift, Path, Spin), AI Denoise and AI Sharpen have no harvested Action Manager event and runMenuItem rejects their ids, so none can be scripted from PGD today; the cards point at ScriptListener, but no recorded descriptor was harvested. Color Lookup has the same hole (the key that carries the LUT file was never harvested).

CorelDRAW tonal adjustments have no scripted route. Levels, Channel Mixer, Color Balance, Hue / Saturation / Lightness and 3D Rotate changed no pixel through ApplyBitmapEffect (now needs_input); the Tune effects (every form raised RPC_E_SERVERFAULT) and Canvas have no scripted form; Block Shadow has no member; the Page Curl, Equalize, Photo Filter and Lighting Effects data sources were never instantiated, so their defaults and ranges are unread. A CorelDRAW-only pipeline cannot correct a photo's tone, and the recipes quietly hand photo work to Photoshop.

Illustrator command routes rest on id pairing. 330 of 697 ai_menu harvest items carry an error (193 with no executeMenuCommand id, 112 with no display name, 10 not a command in this version); of the 300 ai_menu cards marked scriptable yes, 274 say the id was paired by label or shortcut-dialog order and not confirmed by execution; the live confirmation covered 54 items (21 confirmed, 25 inconclusive, 7 refuted). 88 of 136 ai_tool items were not verified live. No DOM route builds an appearance stack (Add New Fill / Add New Stroke are menu-only) and Recolor Artwork has no DOM equivalent.

Path-level results are not verified anywhere. Pathfinder Divide, Trim and Merge (frames identical to the plate: the split lives in the paths), Trap (needs separations), Revolve (Classic) (draws nothing by script), every CorelDRAW shaping command (Weld, Trim, Intersect, Simplify, Front Minus Back: menu cards, no render), Offset Path and Outline Stroke geometry, and the node counts of Image Trace and PowerTRACE. Pixels cannot show these; a geometry read-back can.

Print output is reasoned about, never checked. Overprint, trapping, separations, total ink, rich black, spot plates and PDF/X are 12 recipes with plans, but no PDF or separation output was produced or read (Trap is the only effect tried, and showed no band in a PNG). Illustrator's [Illustrator Default] PDF preset, 2 print presets and 4 transparency-flattener presets have settings the DOM cannot read (7 harvest errors), so their cards cannot quote them; no app has a preflight card of its own.

Multi-page layout and master layers. CorelDRAW master layers have no card of their own (the page-number and page menu cards mention them, the Layers api members carry them, nothing says how to create one or put artwork on it by script), page layout and facing pages are partial menu cards, Illustrator has no masters (the Artboards api card says so), and no recipe builds a multi-page brochure, menu or catalogue with grids, page numbers and repeated elements.

Harvest names a designer cannot search for. 89 CorelDRAW fountain-fill presets and 2 texture libraries are named by resource id (CorelDefaultID_10700 ...), the Envelope (.env) and Shear (.shr) libraries are not decoded, 88 CorelDRAW presets failed to render (mostly undecoded files), one Illustrator Substance material is unnamed, and 6 Photoshop taskspace tools (Refine Edge Brush, Sampling Brush ...) have no id.

weak_cards: Menu cards marked scriptable 'yes' on a guessed route: ai_menu 274 of 300 'yes' cards say the id is not confirmed by execution (Tile and Skew in the sample), ps_menu 124 of 282, cdr_menu 119 of 232. The field has no 'unconfirmed' value, so pgd.find and a plan writer read an id guess as a working route.

566 skeleton api cards (527 enums, 38 type libraries, 1 Action Manager entry) written from the harvest alone and mostly rated high: they restate the type library. ai_api ComposerEngineType lists latinCJKComposer / optycaComposer / adornment without saying which one complex scripts need. Fine as a lookup, thin as knowledge.

ps_menu Middle Eastern Features (medium, scriptable no, not executed): says Photoshop's Middle Eastern and South Asian text engine shapes Devanagari, but gives no route to switch the engine by script or preference and nothing checks the claim.

ps_adjustment Gradient Map (both cards pass): the frames are the default black-to-white map with colours reset, while the cards lead with two-colour brand duotones that no frame shows. The destructive card's avoid line 'the gradient is an object the demo spec cannot carry' is stale since object and list params became settable; the scripting example already builds a two-stop gradient.

ps_adjustment Color Lookup (both cards, needs_input, not rendered): the most common LUT grading route has no harvested key for the LUT file (the LUTFormat / dataOrder / tableOrder probes errored), so the card can only say 'record it with ScriptListener'.

weak_cards.weak: recipe 'Neon tube glow' (confidence high): its Photoshop plan is four separate layer-style steps, each a whole layerEffects set, so a step-by-step run keeps only the Drop Shadow; its Illustrator plan cannot set the glow colours by script (manual step). 21 more Photoshop plans repeat the stacking pattern; until a runner proves a stack they are medium at best.
weak_cards.fixed: 2026-10-13: the 22 Photoshop plans now send each layer's effects as ONE ps_layer_style step with an "effects" list (one layerEffects set; repeated Drop Shadow / Stroke instances go in their multi lists), or move the step to its own layer (Text Effects glitch_rgb duplicates copy 1 before the cyan overlay; text_scrim and quote_card_cutout name a "target"). pgd.check_plan now flags a second whole-style step on the same target (layer style, Styles preset, an Illustrator graphic style after live effects), and all 87 recipes pass it. Still open: no runner has applied a combined set, and the Illustrator glow colours stay a manual step.

weak_cards: Illustrator Drop Shadow, Inner Glow and Outer Glow (pass): correct that the colour (a FillStyle outside the Dict) is not sent by applyEffect, but none proves a scripted way to a coloured shadow or glow (the graphic-style route is named, not tested), and every coloured-glow recipe depends on it.

CorelDRAW Print Merge cards (Create/load Print Merge, Edit Print Merge, Print Merged Document): one-line how, no data-file format (header row, field names, delimiter, encoding), no counter or image-field syntax; scriptable partial only opens the wizard. AI Variables and the Photoshop Data Sets cards offer no scripted fallback either.

PowerTRACE menu cards (Detailed Logo, Logo, Line Art and the other Outline / Centerline Trace presets, partial): the object-model route (Bitmap.Trace, TraceSettings, Finish) is marked unverified and no CorelDRAW trace was ever rendered; Illustrator Image Trace at least has rendered presets.
ps_filter Camera Raw Filter (current, confidence high): high rests on documentation; there is no scripted route and no frame, which the card's own avoid line admits.

202 cards cite files under work/ (154 ps_preset, 31 ps_filter, 7 cdr_effect, 4 cdr_menu, 3 ps_api, 2 ai_effect, 1 cdr_preset), e.g. Clouds, Mosaic Tiles and Texturizer cite a smart-filter probe file; work/ and gallery/ are gitignored, so in the public repo these references, and every verified.frame, point at nothing.

Presets that pass although their note says the look is not visible: Arrow Brush Floral 2 ('no floral detail visible'), Arrow 2.31, Blur-18 px, Bubble Mouse Down, Dots 1. The pass means the text matches a render that hides the preset, not that the preset was seen.

Notes that describe the test photo's people: the Illustrator re-verify report left 9 ai_preset_27 trace cards (16 Colors, 3 Colors, 6 Colors, [Auto-Color], [Black & White], [Default], [Grayscale], [High Color], [Low Color]) describing them; a crude keyword count (person words next to plate / frame / photo) flags up to about 160 more notes, most of them probably retouch wording (skin, face). Notes should describe tones and plate regions only.
doubtful: 'wrong' mostly means 'corrected': all 473 wrong verdicts carry rerender false and a frame, and the card text was rewritten from that frame. 27 of the 41 Photoshop blend modes are 'wrong' because their plate sentence described an earlier plate (only Darker / Lighter Color also had the maths wrong), and 23 of the rendered modes match their formula within 1 level. pgd.find gives a pass only a small bonus, but PGD.md tags these [wrong], so a correct card reads as a faulty one; and the rewritten text matches its frame by construction, so it is not independently verified either.

One render, one plate, one setting per card: every visual verdict is a single frame on one plate (photo, vector, overlap or lens plate) at one demo value. The photo plate is soft and noise-free with no isolated point lights, which hides directional sharpen and smooth (CorelDRAW Directional Smooth's 1:1 crop is indistinguishable from the plate), Reduce Noise and CorelDRAW Remove Noise (not_rendered or near no-op) and Shape Blur's kernel (weak). A pass says the look shows on that plate, not across content.

The photo plate is not shipped: verdict notes quote colours and regions of a third-party photo that the public repo excludes (gallery/ and the plate are gitignored), so a user who re-renders with their own photo cannot compare against them. Shippable synthetic plates would make the verdicts reproducible.

readback_stale filters: for 11 Photoshop filters (Unsharp Mask, Motion Blur, Shape Blur, Surface Blur, Dust & Scratches, Reduce Noise, Minimum, Maximum, Offset, Emboss, Oil Paint) and Add Noise, executeAction's result reports the dialog's last-used values, and the gallery index stores those as 'applied' (Add Noise: applied 12.5 uniform, sent 25 Gaussian). The verdicts infer from pixels that the sent values applied, which is sound reasoning but indirect; the index is not a record of what was applied for these filters.

Preset passes judged on vendor previews: about 396 preset passes (356 CorelDRAW sprayer, media, image-list and painterly files, 40 Illustrator Substance materials) were judged against the file's own shipped preview, not a script render, so they prove the description, not that applying the preset by script gives that look. 14 Lens Flare and 4 Glass presets differ only in colour or flare position, which ApplyBitmapEffect cannot send (not_rendered); 17 Art Style and 16 Bevel preset renders were pixel-identical and have no thumbnail; 4 Point North Star is weak because most of the flare falls outside the photo.

Photoshop brushes by scripted stroke: 5 brush presets still paint a wrong or faint stroke after the renderer fixes (TieDyed Impressionist 25 pixels, Pencil, Watercolor Brush on Dry, Watercolor Salt, Flat Point Scatter No Spacing; weak, rerender true). A scripted Stroke Path is not a hand stroke (no pressure or tilt), so other dynamics-brush passes describe the scripted stroke, not the brush in use.

Illustrator Photoshop Effects pass on a route nobody else uses: the 56 Filter Gallery (PSAdapter) effects render chosen values only through the gallery's apply / save / patch / reopen route (proven pixel-identical to the dialog for Dark Strokes); a plain applyEffect renders the dialog's last-used values. Their verdicts prove the gallery route, which no recipe step or user script reproduces.
Gradient Map (both PS cards) and similar default-only demos: the pass proves the default case (black to white), not the card's headline use (brand duotones).

Tool, menu and api cards are never render-verified by design: 3,414 cards rest on the harvest, a writer and one adversarial review, and many routes say 'unverified' in their own text. Live checks touched a minority (about 380 menu / tool cards say a route was verified live or read back; 54 Illustrator menu items were run by the confirmation script).

Edits after a verdict: 11 Photoshop filter cards had avoid / scripting text fixed while passing, and the Illustrator re-verify corrected the text of 95 cards after an old backup was copied over cards/ during the run. The sampled Photoshop and CorelDRAW corrections survived (Surface Blur / Maximum / Minimum scripting text, 7 CorelDRAW status changes, 38 CorelDRAW preset rechecks), but no full diff of every card against its last verify report has been run.

Second opinions come from the same pipeline: 239 cards carry a second_opinion and agreement was high (Photoshop adjustments / styles / blend modes 60 of 60, CorelDRAW 78 of 80, Illustrator 27 of 38). They are re-reads of the same frame by a similar agent, not an independent render or a human judgement.

Recipes 'built from verified cards' include non-pass steps: of 363 recipe steps on visual cards, 338 use passing cards, 15 use 'wrong' (corrected) cards and 10 use not_rendered ones (CorelDRAW PowerClip x3, Reduce Noise x2, Flatten Effects ...); 54 steps use needs_input items. pgd.py check flags only unusable / hidden / broken, so all of these pass it.

next_steps.step: Clear the public-repo blockers in the cards: rewrite the 202 cards that cite work/ files to cite the harvest field instead (or drop the reference), make verdict notes describe plate regions (bars, ramp, shapes, tones) rather than the photo's content, starting with the 9 ai_preset_27 trace cards; regenerate the README coverage block from python pipeline.py status (it still lists preset batches without cards); rebuild PGD.md with python build_docs.py; run PGD_SCRUB_STRICT=1 python -m unittest tests.test_public_scrub. Also make pgd.py print UTF-8 (sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')): on a cp1252 Windows console python pgd.py find "hindi devanagari" crashes with UnicodeEncodeError on the Arabic-Indic digits in a summary.
next_steps.fixed: 2026-10-13: the pgd.py UTF-8 part only: the CLI reconfigures stdout to UTF-8 (errors replaced), so find no longer crashes on a cp1252 console (test: tests.test_cli, find under PYTHONIOENCODING=cp1252). The other blockers in this step are not part of this fix.

next_steps.step: Fix the verdict vocabulary: add 'corrected' (text rewritten from its frame, rerender false) and 'untested' with a cause (plate / harness / input), migrate the 473 'wrong' cards and the harness-limited not_rendered ones, and teach validate_cards.VERDICT, pgd.find ranking, pgd.check_plan warnings and the build_docs.py legend the new states. Add an 'unconfirmed' scriptable value (or a confirmed flag) for menu routes that were only paired.

next_steps.fixed: 2026-10-15: done (input, target / as / labels, script; checked by pgd.py check). See gaps 1-2.
